question: Chapter 7 measures AVX-512 VNNI slower than AVX2 on this CPU and says the clock was not measured. Measured now.
clock: turbostat --cpu 0 --show Time_Of_Day_Seconds,Bzy_MHz,PkgWatt --interval 0.2, sampled while dotsimd held one kernel on CPU 0
note: Each kernel ran alone on `taskset -c 0` for eight seconds with `--hold 8`; the frequency samples are the ones whose timestamps fall inside the hold window, which the binary prints to stderr. `--only` keeps the scalar kernel for the denominator but times it once, so the clock belongs to the kernel under test. The CPU reports AVX-512F/BW/DQ/VL/VNNI/IFMA/VBMI/VPOPCNTDQ.
invocation: gcc -O3 -mf16c -o dotsimd dotsimd.c -lm; sudo turbostat --cpu 0 --show Time_Of_Day_Seconds,Bzy_MHz,PkgWatt --interval 0.2 & ; for k in avx2 avx512-vnni; do taskset -c 0 ./dotsimd q4_0.gguf 150590816 896 8192 40 --only $k --hold 8; done
